blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — A 41-year-old truck driver decided to take action after tolerating the cheating by his 31-year-old wife for so long. He said that he had forgiven his wife for her three alleged previous affairs. But this fourth time, she left him and their daughter a month ago to go live with her latest boyfriend, a 24-year-old resident of New Bago, Asturias, and allegedly her co-worker.
